clean.description: True exactly when items is empty: no finding is left that a further round of this run can settle.

findings.description: Each thing that is not as the run says it is, or was left out, with what you checked; one only a person can settle says so, and gets no item.

unverified.description: What you could not verify, and why.

items.description: The work items of a further round that would settle the findings; empty where clean is true. As many as the findings need, shaped as a plan's: each sized to one builder's cycle, with its own definition of done, each deciding item with its classes and each that decides none saying why in noClass.

preExisting.description: Issues you met that were there before this run - outside what it changed - each reported and never fixed by you. Empty where you met none.

title.description: One line: what is wrong, and where.

description.description: What is wrong and what it causes, as you saw it.

where.description: The paths, from the repository's root, or the command.

evidence.description: What you read or ran and saw, quoted: the file and its lines, or the command and what it printed.

blocks.description: True only where it stops your own work.
